world.description: Support-reachable canonical family counts for deterministic memory_one_exit policies in the current leave/rematch proxy under different action-tremble semantics.
world.tremble_semantics: Support-level nonzero action error: any intended non-exit action may realize as either C or D.

summary.statement: The current start-support cache gate is a zero-noise artifact; once tremble semantics are introduced, the rematch canonical quotient must be keyed on noise semantics as well as entrant support.
